segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Create an entity to hold the reverb component and // use the concert hall preset. let reverbEntity = Entity() reverbEntity.components.set(ReverbComponent(reverb: .preset(.concertHall))) // Add the reverb entity to the reality view. content.add(reverbEntity) // Load an audio file of a violin. if let violin = try? await AudioFileResource(named: "violin") { // Create an entity for playing the violin audio and // set the spatial audio component. let violinEntity = Entity() violinEntity.components.set( SpatialAudioComponent( directivity: .beam(focus: 0.2) ) ) violinEntity.playAudio(violin) // Add the violin entity to the reality view. content.add(violinEntity) } ```
